why: Items about wiped logos mix watching/repairing with moving after a loss, so the boundary between keeping a work alive and relocating it after erasure is the hardest to hold.

why.T3-021: The item centers on watching and maintaining the logo through repeated losses and rebuilding, with concepts of overrun, dying, working on the logo and maintaining it.

why.T3-087: Concepts name bots, programmed attacks and Holland erasing with scripts, which is tracing who changed the work.

why.T3-035: The item asks r/placeNL's diplomatic thread for a new Dominican flag and coordinates, which is asking a host room for space rather than a first spot on open canvas.
why.T3-022: The old spot is gone and the room agrees to edit the request and rebuild at new coordinates, which is relocating after losing the spot.

multiplacement_log.why_not_one: T3-035 alone would carry the request to the host for a new area but not that the old spot is gone and the room is relocating after loss.
multiplacement_log.why_this_one: C0891691 agrees to edit because the old spot is gone, satisfying T3-022's gate of moving after a lost spot.
multiplacement_log.dispensable: T3-022; dropping it loses the loss-driven relocation context, but the negotiation for new space remains.

why.T3-070: Concepts give rebuild location, template, reference image, template update hopes, and template disputes, which is sharing coordinates and templates for placers.
why.T3-028: Concepts recruit Node.js users for a placement bot and update the bot target, which is running and sharing scripts/bots for the work.

multiplacement_log.why_not_one: T3-070 alone would not carry the bot recruitment and bot-target updates that are distinct from coordinates/templates.
multiplacement_log.why_this_one: C1248787 recruits Node.js users to run a placement bot and C0418043 updates the bot target, satisfying T3-028.
multiplacement_log.dispensable: T3-028; dropping it loses the bot coordination, while the locations and templates remain.

why.T3-021: Concepts show members watching damage and repairing stolen/misplaced pixels, fixing flags by hand and coordinating repairs.
